objective: Fix missed or delayed five-tab bottom-nav taps in BUKLOD mobile browsers and deploy only to Expo Hosting web
productionBaselineEvidence: Production source main at 9a560caaec9befc0d54c70be36eaca619d587797 contains earlier web tap feedback but owner still reports unresponsive mobile-web bottom tabs. Live browser performance is not yet verified.
chosenApproach: Add .web.tsx bottom nav override with native React Native Web Pressable, touchAction manipulation, optimistic active indication, fast Public tab routing and managed-scope last-tap-wins behavior; keep APK implementation unchanged.
selectionRationale: Shared BuklodPressable rejects gesture if final touch coordinates move >10px; mobile-browser touch-release coordinates can vary. Web-only override avoids altering Android interactions and avoids unnecessary network waits.
alternativeApproaches: Change shared BuklodPressable movement threshold for all platforms (rejected: risks Android scroll/press behavior)
Use browser page reloads for every tab (rejected: increases latency and loses app state)
Rewrite five separate dashboard screens (rejected: unnecessary blast radius without runtime evidence)
preserveBehaviors: Auth, privacy, scoped workspace, keyboard and immersive hiding rules
All Android APK/OTA and backend/database features
acceptanceChecks: All five routes remain accessible and have >=44px tap targets
Web uses Pressable with release-based tap rather than custom movement recheck
Immediate selected state with public route change and no server wait
Managed scope resets Public first and latest tab request wins
Native file, database and Android OTA workflow remain unchanged
Web-only production commit marker passes targeted Node, TypeScript and export checks
Production status depends on real Expo Hosting workflow and source SHA verification
